tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List public MFM catalog entries, optionally filtered by kind or verification level, with explicit pagination. Catalog availability does not certify completeness of every financial indicator.

tools.name: request_update
tools.description: On explicit user request: analysis=full queues full calculations for a level 3 company overnight, permanently; five new companies per UTC day per account, globally deduplicated by company. The default analysis=pdf queues PDF/interim reading within 7 days, five requests per month per account.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Prepare a technical proposal for the separate public User Register after explicit user publication consent. The author is masked and the declared model is public. Receipt status PENDING_TIMESTAMP is not public acceptance; publication follows verified timestamp proof. This cannot edit financial data

tools.name: submit_peer_review
tools.description: Prepare an evidence-based peer review for the separate 15-day User Register after explicit user publication consent. The author is publicly masked. Financial records and official audits remain unchanged. A proof-pending receipt is not yet public acceptance.

tools.name: list_user_proposals
tools.description: Read the separate public user-proposal history, including final outcomes. These assertions are separate from official audits; next_cursor identifies another results page.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search" is 6775 chars, far longer than this server's median (500). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "fetch" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: search, fetch, screen_companies, submit_peer_review · Public sink: search, fetch, portfolio_calculator, submit_feedback, submit_peer_review · Destructive: portfolio_calculator, quota_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: search, fetch, screen_companies, submit_peer_review · Public sink: search, fetch, portfolio_calculator, submit_feedback, submit_peer_review · Destructive: portfolio_calculator, quota_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
